grounding.from: A Costco deals site (yepsavings.com, a third-party page) describes the Laird Rd warehouse as serving Mississauga and Oakville. It gives the address as 3180 Laird Rd. This is not an official Costco source.

value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no open Costco in Oakville yet. The first one is going up at 3471 Wyecroft Rd, near Burloak Dr, with a target opening of fall 2027 according to the Oakville Digest (Aug 2026). Until then, Burlington already has one, and a deals site lists a warehouse at 3180 Laird Rd that serves Oakville, though I couldn't confirm that with Costco. I can't tell which is closest to you without knowing where in Oakville you are.
